_comment: Cards that exist only for the reflexive-trigger test (tests/unit/test_reflexive_trigger.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_reflex` is the Espers to Magicite shape: an instruction, and then a 'when you do' half that goes on the stack by itself and picks its target there. `t_inline` is the counterfactual -- the same two sentences run as one resolution.

cards.name: Test Reflex
cards.oracle_text: Exile each opponent's graveyard. When you do, destroy target creature.

abilities.text: When you do, destroy target creature.

cards.name: Test Inline
cards.oracle_text: Exile each opponent's graveyard. Destroy target creature.
